source_policy: Public source-grounded comparisons. Deciding surfaces are minimally normalized into the already-frozen RC7F-B1 bounded grammar with transformations recorded; raw/qualified/scope-bearing surfaces are preserved in cases intended to test safe abstention. No candidate output was observed before cohort creation.
